name: name-field
title: Name field
description: A person's name without the usual mistakes: no forced first and last split, sensible casing on blur and Dutch and other name particles respected.
docs: One field for the whole name; onValueChange receives { full, given, particle, family }. On leaving the field, a name typed all in lower case or all in capitals gets its capitals, with the words in particles (lower case) kept down after the first word. Mixed case is never touched. The change is announced, and Undo restores exactly what was typed and stays undone for that text. splitable adds a Split into parts disclosure (defaultOpen starts it open), and with name the three parts also go out as name-given, name-particle and name-family. splitName, joinName and fixNameCase are exported from name-field/names.
